title: AMC Global Media Returns to NYCC's Main Stage with Standout Panels For New & Returning Series & Never-Before-Seen Previews
summary: The impressive lineup of standout panels for both new and returning fan-favorite series includes Kill Jackie, YAGA, Anne Rice's Mayfair Witches and The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon, plus Shudder faves The Boulet Brothers' Dragula.
body_markdown:
AMC Global Media heads back to New York Comic Con’s Main Stage with an impressive lineup of standout panels for its compelling new and returning fan-favorite series. On Friday, October 9, attendees will get a special preview of two new AMC+ series, including[Kill Jackie](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/kill-jackie--1075708) , starring and executive produced by Catherine Zeta-Jones, and the mysterious, witchy[YAGA](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/yaga--1075517) , as well as a first look at the spellbinding new season of[Anne Rice’s Mayfair Witches](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/mayfair-witches--1059404) and the fourth and final season of[The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/the-walking-dead-daryl-dixon--1060742) . Additionally, on Saturday, October 10, audiences are invited to join *Shudder’s Season of Screams* with the streamer’s annual panel, titled “Shudder Is Here To Scare The S*** Out of You,” featuring filmmakers from some of Shudder’s upcoming films and series, and a panel celebrating a decade of[The Boulet Brother’s Dragula](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/the-boulet-brothers-dragula--1043602) .


Additional details on AMC Global Media's New York Comic Con Panels are below:


[Kill Jackie](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/kill-jackie--1075708) **Panel on Friday, October 9, 3:30-4:00PM, Main Stage**
Series star, Oscar, BAFTA, and Tony Award-winning actress Catherine Zeta-Jones ( *Chicago* , *Wednesday* ) will join showrunner, writer and executive producer Tom Butterworth and executive producer Peter Lawson for a special conversation about the new AMC+ revenge thriller, featuring exclusive sneak peeks at upcoming episodes. Moderated by Collider's Perri Nemiroff.


Premiering Friday, October 2 on AMC+,[Kill Jackie](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/kill-jackie--1075708) follows Jackie Price (Zeta-Jones), who has been living a luxurious existence for the last twenty years – travelling the world, selling fine art and, above all, trying to stay anonymous after escaping a dangerous past as an international drug smuggler. But just as life starts to feel a little boring, it takes a sudden lethal turn when she discovers that The Seven Demons, a squad of the world’s most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her. Assuming someone from her past is behind it, Jackie unleashes her old instincts and embarks on a wild, dangerous game plan: to take down The Demons one by one before they kill her. However, she soon realizes her own demons are much more terrifying than the ruthless killers on her trail… and her buried secrets lead her closer to home, with surprising consequences.


[YAGA](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/yaga--1075517) ****** **Panel on Friday, October 9, 4:03-4:33PM, Main Stage**
Series cast members Carrie-Anne Moss ( *The Matrix* , *Memento* ), Noah Reid ( *Schitt’s Creek* ,[The Vampire Lestat](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/the-vampire-lestat--1073907) ) and Clark Backo ( *Venom: The Last Dance* , *Letterkenny* ) are joined by showrunner, writer and executive producer Kat Sandler and executive producer Mackenzie Donaldson for a panel discussion moderated by TV Guide Magazine and TV Insider’s Damian Holbrook that will feature a sneak preview of the new AMC+ series.


Based on the play by Sandler,[YAGA](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/yaga--1075517) reimagines the Slavic folk tale of the Baba Yaga witch, as a contemporary mystery thriller. It follows Rapp (Reid), a private investigator who arrives in a small coastal town to investigate the disappearance of a young heir to a powerful fishery, Henry Park (Hudson Williams, Heated Rivalry). Rapp finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, Carson (Backo); a charismatic university professor, Katherine (Moss) and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives and ancient magic. Premiering Friday, October 23 on AMC+, *YAGA* is an original series from Canadian streamer Crave, produced by Blink49 Studios and Front Street Pictures in association with Bell Media. *YAGA* is distributed internationally by Sphere Abacus, a Bell Media company.


[Anne Rice’s Mayfair Witches](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/mayfair-witches--1059404) **Panel on Friday, October 9, 4:36-5:16PM, Main Stage**
Series stars Alexandra Daddario, Harry Hamlin, Tongayi Chirisa, Betsy Brandt and Eliza Scanlen, are joined by showrunner and executive producer Esta Spalding and executive producer Mark Johnson for a panel moderated by TV Guide Magazine and TV Insider’s Damian Holbrook, featuring an exclusive sneak peak of the captivating third season ahead of its premiere on AMC and AMC+.


Season 3 picks up in Salem where danger looms over the witches, with Rowan Mayfair (Daddario) at the center of it. As ancient magic collides with new bloodlines, Rowan must wield her rising power and confront forces determined to control the fate of the witches.


[The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/the-walking-dead-daryl-dixon--1060742) ****** **Panel on Friday, October 9, 5:19-6:00PM, Main Stage**
The cast and executive producers of[The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/the-walking-dead-daryl-dixon--1060742) discuss the fourth and final season of the series, alongside the debut of never-before-seen footage previewing the upcoming season. Panelists include executive producer and star Melissa McBride, showrunner and executive producer David Zabel, and executive producer Scott M. Gimple.


In the final season, while crossing the ravaged badlands of Spain, Daryl (Norman Reedus) and Carol (McBride) grasp onto hope – and each other – as uncertainty about their future grows.


[The Boulet Brothers’ Dragula](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/the-boulet-brothers-dragula--1043602) ***: 10 Years of Terror*** **Panel on Saturday, October 10, 2-2:45PM, Room 408**
The Boulet Brothers celebrate a decade of horror, filth and glamour, and open the crypt on the show’s upcoming seventh season. Join modern-day horror icons The Boulet Brothers for an inside look at the making of their biggest season yet, stories from a decade of[Dragula](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/the-boulet-brothers-dragula--1043602) , and an exclusive first look at the new season.


***Shudder Is Here to Scare the S--- Out of You! Celebrating the Season of Screams*** **Panel on Saturday, October 10, 6:30-7:30PM, Room 405**
Shudder special guests join for a discussion on the current state of horror, what scares us the most, and the future of the genre, including a look back at the year, exclusive first looks and what’s to come to the streamer.


Panelists include Ry Barrett ( *In A Violet Nature* ), David Dastmalchian ([Late Night with The Devil](https://www.amcplus.com/movies/late-night-with-the-devil--1067652) ), Ernest Dickerson ([V/H/S/ Mixtape](https://www.amcplus.com/movies/v-h-s-mixtape--1075840) ), and Deborah Ann Woll ( *The Cycle* ). Moderated by Shudder's Director of Programming Angel Melanson.
